entry_item.definition:
a) n Line (obs.); established order system, regime; code of laws; ideology; line of action; norm; often equivalent to suff. "-ism," forming abstract notions.
b) n. Usage, habit, custom.
c) n. Moral obligation; loyalty, virtue.

example.definition: To violate an established order, system, or rule.
To establish as a norm or example.
Internal order or system of an office or institution.
General line of action or policy.
Practice or execution of religious rites and ceremonies.
The great idea, the ideals (Ch. ta-i).

n. Obligations, duties. Justice. A tribunal. A court of justice. Prescriptions, regulations. Right conduct. A stroke, a stripe.

example.definition: To command, to direct. To order.
